findings.summary: Deleting the verdict/marker reset of state.active in executorTurnComplete leaves active true after the post-clear /ai-sdlc:executor turn ends without a marker; taskRunning then stays true until ACTIVE_STALE_MS (30 min), so enqueue wakes from dispatch are consumed without running the executor command and over-threshold rotation is delayed. Fix: clear state.active when a main-thread turn completes with no pendingRotate and no work claimed, or reset active/turnInFlight on the post-clear fresh session; add a test that an enqueue wake runs the executor command right after a turn that ended without a marker.
